The issuer exhibits extremely weak credit metrics: it has negative net income (-$23M), negative shareholders' equity (-$496M) due to massive accumulated deficits (retained earnings of -$1,065M), and liabilities exceeding its assets. Margins are razor-thin (operating margin of 3% and gross margin of 6%), and the current ratio of 1.02 indicates highly constrained liquidity. These factors represent high default risk, placing the issuer deep into the non-investment grade, speculative territory.

DECISION: CCC+
